name: Candle Wish
summary: A birthday cake in a dark room whose candles you blow out with your breath or a hold
about: A two-tier cake glows in a dark room, lit only by flickering striped candles that send up embers and cast a living glow on the wall. Blow into your microphone (or hold the Blow button) and the flames lean, shrink and go out one by one in curls of smoke, until the lights come on with confetti, streamers, balloons and a birthday banner. Good for birthday greetings, party invites or a surprise page for a friend.
how: Pick 1 to 9 candles and type the birthday name.
Press Use microphone and blow until the level bar passes the line; or hold Hold to blow (mouse, finger, Space or Enter), or tap a single flame.
Flames lean with the strength of your blow and go out one by one with smoke and sparks.
When the last one is out the room lights up, confetti and balloons fly and the banner says happy birthday; Light them again relights them one by one.
With reduced motion the flames stay steady, nothing flies and the confetti simply fades in and out.
